concerns.text: Tasks T019 (Topological Contextualization) and T029 (Phase Transition Interpretation) implement Hurst Exponent and DFA metrics. These tasks have no corresponding FR/SC in spec.md. FR-003 explicitly restricts metrics to 'Lempel-Ziv complexity and permutation entropy' only. These tasks constitute scope creep and lack a spec anchor.

Task T009 (Download) references a hardcoded dataset ID 'eeg-fatigue-resting-v1' and a 'metadata URL' not defined in spec.md (FR-001) or plan.md. FR-001 requires identifying a public dataset but does not specify this ID. The task cannot be verified against the spec without a defined source or ID.

Tasks T026 (Monitoring), T027 (Memory), and T028 (Runtime) are required to verify SC-002 and SC-003. However, T026 is marked incomplete/missing implementation details in the task list, and T027/T028 depend on it. Without a functional T026, there is no task to verify the success criteria SC-002 and SC-003.

Task T024 (Collinearity Diagnostics) is marked incomplete ('FAILED: unspecified'). SC-004 requires VIF < 5 diagnostics. Without a completed T024, the success criterion SC-004 has no implementation task to satisfy it.

Task T016 (Feature Extraction) is marked incomplete ('FAILED: unspecified'). FR-003 requires calculating LZC and PE. Without a completed T016, the primary functional requirement FR-003 has no implementation task.

Duplicate Task ID 'T019' exists. Phase 4 T019 is 'Topological Contextualization' (Hurst/DFA). Phase 5 T019 is 'Delta Calculation'. This ID collision makes traceability impossible and indicates a planning error.
